title: Corpus de Documentos Coloniales (CDC) de Mérida, Venezuela — Documentos para la Historia Lingüística de Mérida (siglos XVI-XVII)
institution: Grupo de Lingüística Hispánica, Universidad de Los Andes, Mérida (Enrique Obediente Sosa, ed.)
region: Province of Mérida (Venezuela) and Santa Fe de Bogotá
notes: 37 public and private documents (testaments, powers of attorney, sales, dowries, petitions) transcribed literally (Proyecto Histórico del Español de América / ALFAL norms), published in 2002 (ISBN 980-11-0652-2), each as a separate PDF with text layer. Counts are ours and approximate: words extracted from the 37 PDFs, including headers, archive references and notes; all documents date from 1564-1657. Probably related to the CDHM documents of the same group in the CHARTA corpus. The page shows no update since 2002.
